t: You're in front of the west front of St Paul's Cathedral, looking at the statue of Queen Anne in the forecourt. She was queen of England, Scotland and Ireland from 1702. After the Acts of Union in 1707 she became queen of Great Britain and Ireland, and she reigned until her death in 1714. The statue was made by the sculptors Richard Claude Belt and Louis-Auguste Malempré. It became a Grade II listed building in 1972.
